parsed.name: Arduino模数采集器
parsed.description: 基于Arduino的模数采集装置，通过网络连接读取模拟电压并转换为数字信号，适合实验中采集传感器、电压输出等低速模拟量数据。
parsed.description_en: An Arduino-based analog-to-digital acquisition device that reads analog voltages over a network connection and converts them into digital values. It is suitable for laboratory acquisition of low-speed analog signals such as sensor outputs and general voltage measurements.

actions.description_en: Connect to the Arduino ADC device.
Disconnect from the Arduino ADC device.

actions.description: 采集一次模拟电压并返回对应的数字读数。
actions.description_en: Acquire one analog voltage measurement and return the corresponding digital reading.
